overview.title: JOB OVERVIEW
overview.description: As a tour guide with Ambitious, you'll be responsible for leading groups of travelers through fascinating destinations, sharing your knowledge and experience for each trip. With our team of experienced guides, you'll have the opportunity to meet new clients and make lasting memories. The tour is open to all ages and abilities. We welcome everyone who wants to explore the world. Whether you're looking for adventure or relaxation, we've got something for everyone. Join us on this unforgettable journey!

responsibilities.title: KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
items: Lead tours and provide information about local attractions.
Ensure that all guests are safe and comfortable during the tour.
Manage the tour schedule and ensure that all guests are accommodated.
Provide a high level of customer service to all guests.
Maintain accurate records of guest information.
Assist in the preparation of meals and snacks for the tour.
Ensure that all safety regulations are followed at all times.

aboutCompany.title: ABOUT AKASHBARI
aboutCompany.description: Akashbari is an award-winning travel agency specializing in luxury travel experiences. Our mission is to create unforgettable journeys for our clients. Join us on this exciting journey as we explore the world together. Let us help you create memories that will last a lifetime.

requirements.title: REQUIREMENTS
items: Proven experience in a similar role (at least 2 years).
Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
Strong communication skills and the ability to interact with people from different backgrounds.
A passion for travel and a love of exploring new places.
Excellent organizational and time management skills.
A valid driver's license and access to a reliable vehicle.
A clean driving record and a valid driver's license.
A willingness to learn and adapt to new situations.
A positive attitude and a desire to make a difference.

benefits.title: BENEFITS & PERKS
items: Competitive salary based on experience
Flexible hours to suit individual needs
Access to exclusive discounts and perks
Health insurance and retirement plans
Paid time off for vacation and holidays
Opportunities for professional development
